faqPage.heroSubtitle: How Think4Ever creates shared system understanding and carries it into AI-driven change.

items.q: What is a Think4Ever living blueprint?
items.a: A living blueprint is a persistent, reviewable system map. It connects architecture, dependencies, workflows, business rules, roles and acceptance criteria for people and coding agents.

Code → Design starts with an existing project. Think4Ever analyzes its structure and relationships and presents the system as an inspectable model rather than leaving understanding scattered across files.
“Design” means system design—not only interface design. It includes architecture, workflows, data, roles, business rules and acceptance criteria that should guide implementation.

items.q: Does Think4Ever replace Claude Code, Codex, Cursor or Windsurf?
items.a: No. Teams can build in Think4Ever or use its reviewed blueprint as context for supported external coding tools.

items.q: How does Think4Ever help with change-impact analysis?
items.a: The blueprint connects components, dependencies, workflows and rules so teams can see what a proposed change may affect before execution.

items.q: How does Think4Ever preserve business intent?
items.a: Teams approve business rules and acceptance criteria, then compare proposed implementation with that intent before execution.
Think MCP is the integration layer for making reviewed Think4Ever context available to supported MCP-compatible coding clients.

items.q: Can I start with an existing repository?
items.a: Yes. The Code → Design workflow is specifically intended for understanding and visualizing an existing project.

items.q: Can I begin with a new business objective?
items.a: Yes. The Design → Code workflow begins with the system that should be built and establishes reviewed context before implementation.

items.q: How do I evaluate security and deployment requirements?
items.a: Repository access, model-provider data flows and deployment requirements vary by environment. Review the Trust & Security overview for enterprise details.

privacyPolicyPage.intro1: Thank you for visiting Think4Ever ("we," "us," or "our"). This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and protect your personal information when you visit our website or use our services.
privacyPolicyPage.intro2: By using our Site, you agree to the practices described in this Privacy Policy. Please read this policy carefully. If you do not agree with the terms of this Privacy Policy, please discontinue your use of the Site.
privacyPolicyPage.sec1Text1: We collect information you voluntarily provide when you create an account, submit a contact form, request early access, subscribe to updates, or communicate with us directly. This includes your name, email address, company details, job title, and project requirements.
privacyPolicyPage.sec1Text2: When you visit our Site, we automatically collect certain technical information, including your IP address, browser type, device information, operating system, referring URLs, and interaction patterns through cookies and similar technologies.
privacyPolicyPage.sec2Text: We use the information we collect to provide and improve our services, process requests, personalize user experience, communicate product updates, ensure security and compliance, and analyze application performance.
privacyPolicyPage.sec3Text: We do not sell your personal data. We may share information with trusted third-party service providers (such as hosting, analytics, and authentication partners) solely to operate our platform, or when required by law.
privacyPolicyPage.sec4Text: We implement industry-standard administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your personal data against unauthorized access, alteration, or destruction.
privacyPolicyPage.sec5Text: If you have questions or concerns about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at info@think4ever.com.
